# Surface control audit

*GENERATED by `node app/audit.mjs` from the running app (every beat on the surface, with “show the physics”, in the states where more controls appear, and every microscope). Classes come from the role each scene declares; a ruler with no role, or a control without a stated reason, fails the audit.*

**52 controls:** 18 physical gestures (11 of them inspection), 5 readouts, 6 explicit instruments, 8 advanced precision controls, 12 narrative and 3 representation controls. **Generic sliders: 0.** No problems.

## Beat 0 · Gas occupies real space

| where | control | class | why / what it changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| surface · figure: scan | move along the beam | physical gesture (inspection) | INT-PROBE-001: trace — the probe's place along the beam [Mpc/h] (inspection) |
| surface · figure: grab | the volume (turn it) | physical gesture (inspection) | INT-VIEW-001: drag — the viewpoint — yaw and tilt of the drawing (display only; no physical state) |

## Beat 1 · Same gas, different scale

| where | control | class | why / what it changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| surface · margin: ruler | zoom | explicit instrument | a magnification — a viewpoint on the same gas, like a microscope’s, not a physical state; the instrument’s own setting |

## Beat 2 · One atom meets one colour

| where | control | class | why / what it changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| surface · margin: choice | view | representation | a choice between two ways of looking (one atom and five colours, or one colour and many atoms), not a physical state |
| surface · margin: ruler | atom’s speed along the beam | readout | reports the physical state; takes a precise value only after the gesture is learned, or with “show the physics” |
| surface · figure: grab | push the atom: drag its motion | physical gesture | INT-ATOMV-001: drag — the atom's speed along the beam v [km/s] (v > 0 away from us) |

## Beat 3 · Temperature becomes line width

| where | control | class | why / what it changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| surface · margin: ruler | temperature of the gas | readout | reports the physical state; takes a precise value only after the gesture is learned, or with “show the physics” |

| surface · figure: hold | hold the gas to explore warmer gas | physical gesture | INT-TEMP-001: hold — T [K] |
| surface · figure: scan | touch the census: which atoms are these? | physical gesture (inspection) | INT-THERM-BIN-001: dwell — speed along the beam (one bin) [km/s] |
| surface · figure: scan | the line (which atoms absorb here?) | physical gesture (inspection) | INT-THERM-BIN-001: dwell — speed along the beam (one bin) [km/s] |
| microscope “gaussian” · margin: ruler | atoms counted | advanced precision | a microscope sweeps one variable for controlled, quantitative exploration |

## Beat 4 · The atom's lifetime leaves faint, far wings

| where | control | class | why / what it changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| surface · margin: choice | step | narrative | a chain of reasoning (a short life → a spread of colours → the core is motion → the wings are lifetime), not a physical state |
| show the physics · margin: ruler | temperature | advanced precision | the claim (lifetime → wings) does not need it; on the surface it would be a second temperature gesture after Beat 3’s hold, so it is a precision control in “show the physics” |
| microscope “lifetime” · margin: ruler | lifetime, relative to the real 1.6 ns | advanced precision | a microscope sweeps one variable for controlled, quantitative exploration |
| microscope “voigt” · margin: ruler | damping drawn exaggerated by | advanced precision | a microscope sweeps one variable for controlled, quantitative exploration |

## Beat 5 · The same colour, stretched

| where | control | class | why / what it changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| surface · margin: choice | step | narrative | bookmarks along the journey of the light (the drag of the light is primary) |
| surface · margin: button | play the whole journey ▸ | narrative | plays the journey of the light end to end |
| surface · figure: grab | drag the light | physical gesture | INT-LIGHT-001: drag — where the light is — its comoving distance along the path from the quasar (z_q = 3.2) to us [Mpc/h] |
| surface · figure: select | select another structure | physical gesture (inspection) | INT-STRUCT-001: tap — which structure is followed |
| show the physics · margin: toggle | logarithmic ruler | advanced precision | a choice of representation for the ruler (show the physics) |
| show the physics · margin: choice | express the recorded spectrum in | advanced precision | the frame selector for exact repeats; the squeeze is the gesture (show the physics) |
| show the physics · figure: grab | hold a shadow and pull it back toward Lyα | physical gesture | INT-SQUEEZE-001: squeeze — the stretch undone — the recorded spectrum divided by (1 + z) for a frame between ours and the quasar's |

## Beat 6 · Where does one parcel land?

| where | control | class | why / what it changes |
|---|---|---|---|
| surface · margin: ruler | where it is (distance along the beam) | readout | reports the physical state; takes a precise value only after the gesture is learned, or with “show the physics” |
| surface · margin: ruler | its own motion along the line of sight | readout | reports the physical state; takes a precise value only after the gesture is learned, or with “show the physics” |
| surface · margin: ruler | temperature of the gas | readout | reports the physical state; takes a precise value only after the gesture is learned, or with “show the physics” |
| surface · margin: ruler | how much neutral hydrogen (atoms per cm² along the beam) | explicit instrument | no gesture is physically honest for adding neutral atoms (touching or squeezing gas does not create them; enlarging the gas would change its size, not N_HI); what sets the amount in nature is in the microscope |
| surface · margin: button | replay: it lands, then heat widens its line | narrative | the quiet replay of the first-encounter reveal (once per session): it lands, as wide as its size spreads it, then heat widens its line |
| surface · margin: button | back to the toy’s parcel | narrative | restores the toy’s parcel after the reader has moved, pushed, warmed or re-set it |
| surface · figure: grab | its motion arrow (push it) | physical gesture | INT-PUSH-001: drag — the parcel's line-of-sight peculiar velocity v_pec [km/s] (its place, temperature and amount are fixed) |
| surface · figure: hold | move the gas along the beam | physical gesture | INT-PLACE-001: drag — the parcel's comoving place x along the beam [Mpc/h] (its amount, temperature and own motion are fixed); INT-WARM-001: hold — the parcel's temperature T [K] (its place, motion and amount are fixed) |
| microscope “bleach” · margin: ruler | ultraviolet background, relative to this toy’s (tuned, not measured) | advanced precision | a microscope sweeps one variable for controlled, quantitative exploration |

| surface · figure: scan | velocity space (which gas lands here?) | physical gesture (inspection) | INT-VSCAN-001: dwell — a velocity-space coordinate u [km/s] (the window's range) |
